PullRequest.Title: sessions: defer new-session onboarding while welcome is visible
PullRequest.Body:

## Summary

Prevent new-session onboarding tours from appearing over the Agents window welcome/Get Started modal.

- Add the existing `!sessionsWelcomeVisible` context-key condition to the original New Session tour, New Session View tour, and shared eligibility expression for the V2 and V3 view tours.
- Preserve all other eligibility conditions and allow tours to become eligible normally after the modal closes.
- Add regression coverage verifying all four variants are eligible before the modal, blocked while it is visible, and eligible again after dismissal.

## Validation

Passed: **26 targeted tests** with:

```bash
./scripts/test.sh --reporter dot --run src/vs/sessions/contrib/onboardingTours/test/browser/newSessionViewV2Tour.test.ts --run src/vs/sessions/contrib/onboardingTours/test/browser/newSessionViewV3Tour.test.ts --run src/vs/sessions/contrib/onboardingTours/test/browser/newSessionViewTourTrigger.test.ts --run src/vs/sessions/contrib/onboardingTours/test/browser/newSessionTourContribution.test.ts
```

Passed: changed-file ESLint with:

```bash
npm run eslint -- src/vs/sessions/contrib/onboardingTours/browser/tours/newSessionTour.ts src/vs/sessions/contrib/onboardingTours/browser/tours/newSessionViewTour.ts src/vs/sessions/contrib/onboardingTours/browser/tours/newSessionViewTourShared.ts src/vs/sessions/contrib/onboardingTours/test/browser/newSessionViewV2Tour.test.ts
```

Passed: `git diff --check`.

Full-client build attempts were blocked by existing local dependency issues:

- `npm run build-fast -- --client-only` failed because the manifest declares Copilot runtime `1.0.102`, but the installed `@github/copilot-sdk` bundles `1.0.92-5`.
- `npm run transpile-client` generated the client test modules, then failed to bundle agent-host crypto because `@hpke/core` is missing. The targeted tests above subsequently ran successfully against the generated output.

No dependency versions were changed. Full type-checking and manual UI verification were not run.

Scenarios.Scenario: Opening and dismissing the Agents welcome/Get Started UI while a new-session onboarding trigger is active
Scenarios.CriticalPath: SessionsSetUpService synchronously sets or resets sessionsWelcomeVisible; OnboardingService already reevaluates registered scenarios on every context-key change. The changed expressions add one constant-time predicate per affected scenario. While visible, eligibility stops before enqueue/presentation; after dismissal, normal eligibility and the existing serialized presentation path may proceed.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Reads the default account and may await setup completion while constructing the first-launch welcome flow.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: At most once for the first-launch welcome invocation, independent of the four onboarding predicates.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same account/setup reads occurred before the diff; an eligible onboarding presentation could be scheduled while the welcome UI was visible.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The welcome flow already awaits this work; the changed eligibility expressions neither add it nor wait on it.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Renders onboarding UI and emits bounded shown/outcome telemetry when a tour actually displays.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: At most one non-repeatable sibling sharing the seen key is scheduled; the queue serializes presentations and deduplicates by scenario id.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: An eligible tour could enter the same serialized presentation path before the welcome UI closed.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The diff defers this existing work until sessionsWelcomeVisible resets instead of allowing it to overlap the welcome UI.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Four registered new-session tour variants among the bounded onboarding registry; each global context change already caused a registry scan before this diff.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: OnboardingService deduplicates pending/in-flight scenario IDs, claims the shared seen key across variants, sorts a single queue, and pumps presentations serially. The added gate does not create parallel work.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Seen-state and resolved experiment state are reused across evaluations. Cold experiment states remain ineligible until assignments resolve; warm states use in-memory values. The new predicate adds no cache, key growth, misses, or retries.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the changed lines only extend ContextKeyExpr conjunctions, and the traced service already subscribes to every context-key change and serializes eligible presentations.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Registry size and context-change frequency vary, but the diff adds only four primitive expression checks to an already-existing evaluation pass and suppresses rather than adds presentation work while welcome is visible.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The only new runtime cost is bounded constant-time predicate evaluation; expensive account/setup and presentation boundaries are not introduced or multiplied.

Scenarios.Scenario: Normal new-session onboarding eligibility after the welcome UI is absent or dismissed, across original, view, V2, and V3 variants
Scenarios.CriticalPath: An existing observable/context event invokes OnboardingService._evaluate, which scans registered scenarios, evaluates the extended when expression, consults in-memory experiment/seen state, and may enqueue one eligible tour. The predicate is satisfied when the welcome key is false, so downstream behavior remains on the existing path.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Fetches two assignment treatments for each experiment-backed scenario.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One coalesced in-flight read pair per scenario, retried only after assignment refetch semantics; not triggered by evaluating sessionsWelcomeVisible.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same experiment treatment reads and gating occurred before the diff.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Eligibility waits for previously resolved experiment state, but the new context predicate does not initiate or increase these reads.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Creates and runs spotlight/sequence UI and emits bounded telemetry for the selected tour.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One selected variant because siblings share a seen key; presentations are globally serialized by the onboarding queue.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same presentation and telemetry work occurred when the existing trigger and eligibility conditions matched.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: This is the existing downstream critical path once eligibility succeeds; the diff changes only whether it starts before or after welcome dismissal.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Bounded number of registered onboarding scenarios and exactly four affected variants; no user-sized collection, history, file set, or message stream is introduced.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: One presentation at a time; duplicate IDs join an existing run and shared seen-key claiming suppresses sibling variants in the same pass.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Warm seen and experiment state skip or cheaply admit scenarios; cold unresolved experiments remain gated. No positive/negative cache behavior changes.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: call flow and queue/coalescing behavior are explicit in OnboardingService, and no filesystem, IPC, subprocess, database, or newly introduced network operation is reached by the changed expressions.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Exact registry cardinality is not material because the scan pre-existed and the diff adds a fixed number of boolean terms.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. Work after dismissal is the same bounded, coalesced onboarding work that existed before, with timing intentionally deferred.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance pass over all four changed files and all diff pages. Traced welcome-key updates through onboarding eligibility, experiment state, shared seen-key coalescing, the serialized presentation queue, UI rendering, telemetry, and account/setup boundaries. The PR adds only bounded context-expression checks and defers existing presentation work; it introduces no actionable performance regression.
